name: Lyo.Story.Client
tagline: Typed HTTP client for story graph save/load and play.
description: Calls graph save, graph load by id or slug, story delete, and playthrough start/choose/advance/events/causes. Row list and filter stay on `IApiClient.QueryConcreteAsync` against `Story/Stories`. Sit it on an `IApiClient`.
features: `IStoryClient` matches the graph and play routes on `BuildStoryGroup`.
`ListGraphsAsync(StoryListReq)` posts to `Story/graph/list` and returns the graph headers for one tenant and game.

`StoryClientStore` implements `IStoryStore` over `IStoryClient`, so game code can use a remote Story API through the same interface as `Lyo.Story.Sqlite` (this is what `Lyo.Game.Runtime` does in Remote and Hybrid). Remote failures surface as the client's HTTP exceptions, not as `GameApiUnavailableException`.
